claims: Discussions regarding the 25th Amendment and Donald Trump resurfaced as of April 2026.
Section 4 of the 25th Amendment allows the Vice President and a majority of the Cabinet to remove a president deemed unable to discharge their duties.
Reports indicate calls for removal followed Donald Trump's Easter social media posts containing threats against the Strait of Hormuz.
Under Section 4 of the 25th Amendment, if the President contests their removal, the Vice President keeps power only if two-thirds of both the House and Senate agree.
The 25th Amendment has never been used.
The 25th Amendment was previously discussed regarding Donald Trump in 2021 following the Capitol riot.
